fix-eos-configuration.handoff: EOS's own configuration does not load. Fix only the reported file(s); change nothing else.

complete-local-activation.handoff: Walk the one-time activation: declare .eos/project.json, branch protection, CODEOWNERS, approval baseline.

frame-the-problem.handoff: Converge the idea into one falsifiable problem statement with a measurable success metric, and record it in docs/discovery.md + docs/discovery.json.

expand-requirements.handoff: Expand the approved problem into functional + NFR + operational-readiness requirements in docs/requirements.md + docs/requirements.json. Every operational concern is ADOPT / SKIP+reason / DEFER+owner+trigger.

write-prd.handoff: Turn docs/requirements.md into docs/prd.md; every requirement gets addressable AC<n>.<n> ids that the PRD DEFINES, not merely mentions.

repair-prd.handoff: Repair only the listed PRD defects (undefined/duplicate AC ids, uncovered requirements, unresolved blockers). Do not restructure the PRD.

design-ux.handoff: Produce docs/DESIGN.md + docs/EXPERIENCE.md and docs/design.json, or record { "userInterface": false, "skipReason": "..." } for a non-user-facing product.

design-architecture.handoff: Design the architecture, lock the tech stack and the deployment topology in ADRs, and record every decision in docs/architecture.json.

plan-stories.handoff: Slice the approved architecture into context-self-contained stories under docs/stories/.

design-acceptance-tests.handoff: Create the missing acceptance-test intent for the listed acceptance criteria only.

design-eval-cases.handoff: Add an eval case (EVAL-<n>) for each LLM-backed acceptance criterion listed; do not touch the others.

complete-story-readiness.handoff: Close the listed story-readiness gaps (telemetry / authorization / rollback / dependencies) only.

justify-classification.handoff: This change type turns verification gates off. Record in the story front matter why that is legitimate — EOS records the decision, it does not make it.

refresh-stale-evidence.handoff: Nothing is wrong with the work — an input moved, so the recorded proof no longer describes it. Re-run the gates in order.

promote-story.handoff: Everything the gate requires is in place; record the evidence and promote the story.

implement-story.handoff: Implement the ready story exactly to its acceptance criteria; do not widen scope.

verify-story.handoff: Run the declared quality commands, then produce the trace-matrix rows AND the machine test-run summary (docs/evidence/test-run.json) for this story's acceptance criteria.

repair-verification.handoff: Fix the failing checks listed by the verified gate. Do not edit tests to make failures green.

build-trace-matrix.handoff: Map every listed acceptance criterion to a real test in docs/trace-matrix.md, and make the runner emit docs/evidence/test-run.json so the result is executed, not asserted.

record-spike-outcome.handoff: Write the spike's decision record; a spike never merges product code without a follow-up story.

prepare-release.handoff: Walk the release gate for the candidate; record evidence, do not approve anything yourself.

repair-release.handoff: Close the listed release blockers only, then re-run the release-ready gate.

land-telemetry.handoff: The change is live. Land the observability that makes it judgeable: the success metric as a real signal, dashboards, routed alerts, and a rollback trigger.

repair-telemetry.handoff: Close only the listed observability gaps in docs/telemetry.json, then re-run the telemetry-ready gate.

review-incident.handoff: This release was rolled back. Establish what happened before anything ships again, and write the correction back into the requirements, the PRD and (for an agentic product) the eval dataset.

close-the-loop.handoff: Write the change back to the spec source of truth and open the next iteration.

start-next-change.handoff: Nothing is blocked. Start the next change from a requirement, not from code.
